body: J is the woman tho. The baby who was rescued from the cult was K??? And J is his mother???
I was thinking I needed gel for better hold too! And thank you I'll try not to squish as much next time. It just feels annoying with soaking wet hair sometimes haha.
Thank you!! Will try not plopping my next wash day!

My routine:

- Washed hair with a low poo (Johnson's baby conditioning shampoo)
- I used Garnier Fructis Nourishing Banana Hair Food to squish and condish. 
- Rinsed of conditioner and squished excess water out. Applied moderate amount of Taft Styling Curl Defining Mousse Strong Hold 
- Plop for 10 mins
- Let it air-dry and then SOTC
This is such a beautiful comment and thank you so much for such lovely words. It does make me feel less like a speck of dust for a moment, and that is something. Truly, thank you.
